description: An ALIAS of search_jobs in the fixed shape ChatGPT's deep-research and company-knowledge connectors call: one query string in, {results:[{id,title,url}]} out. Every result's id is the job id fetch and every other tool take; url is the posting's page on resumebooster.work, where the employer's apply link is. Same board, same ranking and the same 10-row page as a keyless search_jobs; the disclosures ride beside the results. Any other client should call search_jobs, which takes every filter.

query.description: Free text — title, skills, a place, exclusions with a leading minus.
